$comment: Curated dark-sky spots in Iceland. Edit freely — no code changes needed. Coordinates are approximate (±1 km); always verify parking and access on site. bortle: 1 pristine … 9 city.

spots.name: Grótta Lighthouse
spots.parking: Car park at the end of Seltjarnarnes
spots.notes: Closest decent spot to the city. Causeway floods at high tide, so check before crossing.

spots.name: Kleifarvatn
spots.notes: Dark lake 30 min from Reykjavík, with reflections on calm nights.
spots.access: Road 42 can be icy; no winter service at times

spots.name: Garðskagaviti
spots.parking: Large car park by the lighthouses
spots.notes: Two lighthouses make a classic foreground. Close to Keflavík airport.

spots.name: Reykjanesviti & Gunnuhver
spots.notes: Steam from Gunnuhver adds atmosphere. Very windy; mind the cliffs.

spots.name: Þingvellir
spots.notes: UNESCO site, very dark, about 45 min from Reykjavík. Stay on marked paths.

spots.name: Kerið crater
spots.notes: Crater rim with a wide-open sky. Slippery in winter.

spots.name: Gullfoss
spots.notes: Lower path often closed in winter; use the upper viewpoint.

spots.name: Seljalandsfoss
spots.notes: Waterfall foreground. The path behind the fall is icy and often closed in winter.

spots.name: Skógafoss
spots.notes: Aurora appears above the waterfall when you face north.

spots.name: Sólheimasandur car park
spots.notes: Very dark, flat sand plain. The plane wreck is a 4 km walk; don't attempt it at night in bad weather.

spots.name: Reynisfjara viewpoint
spots.notes: Sneaker waves kill people here. Stay well back from the water, especially at night.

spots.name: Jökulsárlón
spots.parking: Car parks on both sides of the bridge
spots.notes: Icebergs plus aurora reflections. Iconic.

spots.name: Diamond Beach
spots.notes: Ice on black sand. Waves are dangerous; don't stand on the ice.

spots.name: Stokksnes / Vestrahorn
spots.notes: Mountains and dunes. Fee paid at the café; the road is gated at night sometimes.

spots.name: Lagarfljót, Egilsstaðir
spots.notes: Inland east is often clearer than the coast in onshore winds.

spots.name: Dettifoss (west side)
spots.notes: Extremely dark. The road may not be serviced in winter.

spots.name: Hverir / Námaskarð
spots.notes: Steaming vents in front of the aurora. Stay on paths; the ground is boiling hot.

spots.name: Mývatn, Reykjahlíð shore
spots.notes: Inland and often clearer than the coast.

spots.name: Goðafoss
spots.notes: Easy access from road 1, 35 min from Akureyri.

spots.name: Eyjafjörður east shore
spots.view: W over the fjord to Akureyri
spots.notes: Town lights reflect on the fjord; it gets darker further north.

spots.name: Hvítserkur
spots.notes: A sea-stack silhouette facing north.

spots.name: Kirkjufell
spots.view: S–W to the mountain (aurora N overhead)
spots.notes: The most photographed mountain in Iceland. Busy on clear nights.

spots.name: Búðir black church
spots.notes: A lone black church on lava with aurora overhead.

spots.name: Akranes lighthouse
spots.notes: 45 min from Reykjavík through the tunnel. Twin lighthouses.

spots.name: Dynjandi
spots.notes: Remote and spectacular.
spots.access: Road 60 often closed in winter; check umferdin.is
